personal_info.name: Roma Kay
personal_info.current_headline: Vice President - Global Sales Operations at Wesco | Senior Sales and Customer Service Professional
personal_info.summary: An experienced and result oriented Senior Sales and Customer service professional with strong work ethics and excellent time management skills. Consistently takes the lead to track down and resolve issues affecting service delivery. Able to operate efficiently with minimal direct supervision under tight timelines. Able to learn and adapt quickly to the ever-changing needs of a business environment. Long track record of providing outstanding customer service support. Recipient of Award of Excellence in 2009 – This award is Anixter’s most prestigious honour to employees that demonstrate Anixter’s philosophy to providing excellence for co-workers, customers and partners.

experience.title: VP Global Sales Operations
experience.description: Wesco International builds, connects, powers and protects the world. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Wesco is a FORTUNE 500® company with more than $22 billion in annual sales and a leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions. Wesco offers a best-in-class product and services portfolio of Electrical and Electronic Solutions, Communications and Security Solutions, and Utility and Broadband Solutions. The Company employs approximately 20,000 people, partners with the industry's premier suppliers, and serves thousands of customers around the world. With millions of products, end-to-end supply chain services, and leading digital capabilities, Wesco provides innovative solutions to meet customer needs across commercial and industrial businesses, contractors, government agencies, educational institutions, telecommunications providers, and utilities.

experience.title: Vice President - Global Sales Operations
experience.description: In 2020, Wesco acquired Anixter International Inc., a leading global distributor of network & security solutions, electrical & electronic solutions, and utility power solutions. The merger resulted in a combined company with a comprehensive and balanced portfolio that united Wesco's capabilities in industrial, construction, and utility with Anixter’s expertise in data communications, security, and wire and cable.

experience.title: Director of Sales - IBM Global Program
experience.description: Worked closely with the VP of sales to help develop, co-ordinate and drive key initiatives within the IBM Global Program. Based on reports from various teams, worked with VP of Sales and VP of Business Development to budget, forecast and prepare business plan. Interacted with various order processing teams in different geographies on all queries, quotes and follow ups on orders. Interacted with various sales teams across North America addressing their questions and providing help as required for various pre and post sales issues. Maintained and updated a central database as a knowledge base for Anixter teams globally. Responsible for maintaining and updating the group’s home page on Anixter’s internal website, including pricing information, vendor information, important notices.

experience.title: Manager of Business Development - Global Accounts
experience.description: Supported the IBM Global team within all geos in the day to day quote, orders, invoicing and credit issues. Worked closely with the VP of Sales to ensure all new initiatives within the IBM program were fully documented and rolled out to the various internal sales teams and geo leads within the Anixter/IBM team. Supported IBM on various cabling and security projects. Was responsible for the day to day quotes, vendor pricing, order placement, order updates to the Project Manager, inventory and shipping updates along with Return Material requests and any invoicing issues.

experience.title: Internal Sales Supervisor
experience.description: Consistently achieved and exceeded sales targets. Successfully mastered the company’s mainframe computer system for prospecting, quoting customers, processing orders and customer database management. Actively involved in all logistical issues concerning order management from the point of sale to the delivery of goods to the customer and any fault reports/short shipments. Effectively managed customers in different geographical locations like Kenya, Nigeria, Oman, Pakistan, South Africa, Egypt, Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. Successfully managed the System Integrator (SI) Program in partnership between Anixter and Systimax Solutions (formerly Avaya Communications). Responsible for providing sales forecasts to Regional Sales Director with input from partners, an actively managed project board and helped drive the resellers to achieve and exceed these targets.
